items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Then I joined a man called Jerry Jackson, from Nashville, Tennessee. He played the Cavaliers show. I worked with him about a couple years.

ctx.x: And first were the Bronze Mannequins, and then when? And then who were some of the others?

Well, now I'm going to tell you, the Bronze Mannequins, this year he played the Heaney Brothers. And they shared he had two calls, he put one band over on the Heaney Brothers and one band on James C. Straits. Well I'd manage this band, some other fellow managed that band. Well I still would try to tell you about four years, but he sent for his brother and gave his brother a show, and he was such a wild catcher, you know, couldn't nobody get along with him, so I just quit my whole outfit. After about three or four…
